newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has decided to relax from Wednesday the limit of day-to-day movement in share prices from existing five percent to 10 percent.
Police in Dhaka has formed 10 special teams ahead of the new year celebration to crack down on unruly revellers during late Tuesday night and early Wednesday morning.
Dhaka and London will discuss the possibility of British investment in the energy sector of Bangladesh during Prime Minister John Major's forthcoming visit.
The government has removed two top-ranking officials of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in a move to reacast the regulatory body.
Over 2.5 million devotees from home and abroad on Monday joined the concluding prayer of Biswa Ijtema, the second biggest congregation of muslims after the hajj, in Tongi near capital Dhaka.
The demand of dollar in the domestic market fell to its lowest level in 1996 because of hectic trading in stock markets, a "Currency Review" by the Standard and Chartered Bank said.
